message:
Reskin to Zoho CRM palette; clickable dashboard + student search

- Rebuild the color system around Zoho's brand palette: Honolulu Blue
  primary, Sea Green / gold / Amaranth Red semantic states, cool light-gray
  ground, light monochrome sidebar. Modernized the native <select> dropdowns.
- Make CEO dashboard cards navigate (revenue→finances, status counts→filtered
  students, students→students, payroll→payroll, trend→analytics); add optional
  href to Stat. Students reads ?status= from the URL for deep links.
- Add live name/phone search to the student list (client-side) with a clear
  button; add "clear" i18n string.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
